text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I spot Mejiro Ardan, Mejiro Ryan, and Daiwa Scarlet chatting in the corner of the cafeteria.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Really?! I didn't know you two like shojo manga!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Why, yes. Reading is a treasured pastime of mine, and shojo manga has something to offer every generation.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Y-yeah. I've read a couple too…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Oh? Is something the matter, Ryan? You keep looking over your shoulder…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Uh, well… It would be a little embarrassing if everyone found out I read romanc—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Ah, ahem! I mean, no real reason!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: So! Have either of you read any good ones lately?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Let me think, um…

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: I read "Love Passing Love" and it was great! There's this scene in a classroom after school where the main character realizes her childhood friend likes likes her!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: And it's the perfect moment for her friend to open up… but they can't muster up the courage—and the main character ends up pushing them away!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: I know it's a cliche, but for me, the real charm of romance comics is those scenes where you have two characters struggling to convey their feelings for each other!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: You're absolutely right. The opposite always works wonders too, when you have lovers whose feelings are in sync, but fate keeps throwing obstacles their way.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Oh, I know just what you mean! There's also—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Ah… N-never mind…

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: What about you, Ryan? Have you read any good manga recently?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Me?! Oh, um… I recommend…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Um, I… Well…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: O-oh! Sorry! I just haven't had time to read much… Ardan, could you recommend something instead?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Very well. I shall do so.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: I must admit, historical and fantasy settings appeal very much to me. The last comic I read, "Distant Dragon River," was one such title.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: The two leads are deeply in love, but they're also leaders of warring nations. In one particularly memorable scene, the two secretly meet under the cover of darkness to negotiate a truce.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: I-i-in secret? R-really?!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Yes… For the heart-wrenching truth is that this is the only way they can meet anymore.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Knowing that so many lives are depending on them, they're forced to suppress their emotions and focus solely on the negotiations…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: However, after seeing one another's faces, it's not long before they stop negotiating and start reminiscing about days gone by… Their feelings soon win out…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: The distance between them grows smaller and smaller… Their fingers intertwine—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: …Wha-wha-wha! EEEEEK!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: I c-can't handle this anymore!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Mejiro Ryan cries out as she runs right past me and off to who knows where…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Ryan, what's wrong?! Oh? Hello, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: …Did you overhear our conversation just now? Did I… happen to say something strange to Ryan?
choice_data_list: …She wasn't quite ready for that kind of detail yet.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: She wasn't ready? What do you mean by that?
choice_data_list: I think that might've been too much to take in all of a sudden…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Now that you mention it, the part I recounted was the climax of the middle act… Oh dear, I believe that might have been a "spoiler," as they say.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Ah… How careless of me. I must remember to be more cautious when giving recommendations.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I think she might be missing the point somewhat… but at least she looks committed to bettering herself.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: So that's it… Well, it is true—your recounting of the story was fantastic, Ardan!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: But to run off all of a sudden like that… Ryan must be quite the emotional type.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Yes. Ryan's always been somewhat sensitive…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Which is precisely why I hoped she'd open up and recommend a comic that stirred all those emotions of hers…

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Now I'm really curious… Next time the opportunity arises, I'd love to hear what Ryan has to say!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Indeed… Well, when that day comes, be sure to take a comfortable seat. Hehe.
